title: Drunk Lady's INSANE Airport Meltdown
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On March 17th, 2023 in Texas. Officers were called to the airport in regards a woman who took a swing at a gate agent. She seemed to be in an altered mental state due to how she was acting, she didn't seem to know where she was and kept crying. When the officers deemed it was appropriate to arrest her, she started going insane.  This is footage of the events that followed.
